stem: [洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法]以下哪些是提高员工对金融犯罪相关风险的认识和培训的最佳实践？(选择三项.)

options.A: 为所有员工量身定制培训计划并定期提供培训
options.B: 在日常运营之外开展培训,提高合规意识
options.C: 仅在入职时对相关员工进行一次核心反洗钱主题的培训.
options.D: 采用多种培训方法,并为员工提供必要的资源
options.E: 定期沟通并衡量培训效果

stem_en: Which of the following are best practices to raise awareness and train staff regarding the risks related to financial crime? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: Tailor training and offer regular training to all employees.
options_en.B: Train outside of daily operations and promote awareness of compliance.
options_en.C: Train relevant employees on core AML topics only once at onboarding.
options_en.D: Use a variety of training methods and provide necessary resources to employees.
options_en.E: Communicate regularly and measure the effectiveness of training.
